En esta federación nos enfocamos en uno de los objetivos mas grandes del mundo Hattrick. La colección de banderas. si estas interesado en formar parte para completar tu colección y ayudar a los demás a completarla eres bienvenido.
In this federation we focus on one of the biggest goals in the Hattrick world. The collection of flags. If you are interested in taking part to complete your collection and help others to complete it, you are welcome.
Ziel der Föderation ist es, Mitgliedern zu Flaggen zu verhelfen.

We offer all the new flags in this Federation for free.
Also we have a very active community when it comes to Achievements. If you're looking for any information on how to get achievements or you need help from others to get those achievements, this is the place to be. Also collecting flags will give you achievement points, so all the more reason to join!

You like to collect flags, but don't get the difficult one? This federation in Hattrick is based on the feature of receiving country flags for playing international friendlies. Don't hesitate, just click on become a member and join us.
